metadata.description: Publishes the Node.js API and synthetic traffic-generator website after the hosting resources have been provisioned. Uses an ARM deployment script with a dedicated user-assigned managed identity.
Location for the deployment script and its managed identity.
Name of the App Service Web App that receives the Node.js API package.
Name of the Azure Static Web App that receives the website content.
Full APIM URL, including the API path, injected into website/assets/config.js.
Public ZIP archive containing the api and website folders.
Change this value to force the deployment script to publish the application content again.

properties.scriptContent:
set -euo pipefail

work_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$work_dir"' EXIT
cd "$work_dir"

curl --fail --silent --show-error --location "$SOURCE_ARCHIVE_URL" --output source.zip
python3 -m zipfile -e source.zip source
source_root="$(find source -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | head -n 1)"
if [ -z "$source_root" ]; then
  echo "The source archive did not contain a repository directory." >&2
  exit 1
fi

node_version="20.18.0"
curl --fail --silent --show-error --location "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${node_version}/node-v${node_version}-linux-x64.tar.gz" --output "$work_dir/node.tar.gz"
python3 -c "import tarfile, warnings; warnings.simplefilter('ignore', DeprecationWarning); tarfile.open('$work_dir/node.tar.gz', 'r:gz').extractall('$work_dir')"
export PATH="$work_dir/node-v${node_version}-linux-x64/bin:$PATH"
export npm_config_cache="$work_dir/npm-cache"
export DOTNET_SYSTEM_GLOBALIZATION_INVARIANT=1

cd "$source_root/api"
npm ci --omit=dev
python3 -m zipfile -c "$work_dir/api-release.zip" package.json package-lock.json src node_modules

for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
  if az webapp deploy --resource-group "$TARGET_RESOURCE_GROUP" --name "$TARGET_WEB_APP" --src-path "$work_dir/api-release.zip" --type zip --clean true --restart true --timeout 600000 --only-show-errors; then
    break
  fi
  if [ "$attempt" = "6" ]; then
    echo "The API package could not be deployed after 6 attempts." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 20
done

cd "$work_dir/$source_root/website" 2>/dev/null || cd "$OLDPWD/../website"
website_dir="$(pwd)"
printf "window.DEFAULT_API_BASE_URL = window.DEFAULT_API_BASE_URL || '%s';\n" "$API_GATEWAY_URL" > assets/config.js

static_site_token=""
for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
  static_site_token="$(az staticwebapp secrets list --resource-group "$TARGET_RESOURCE_GROUP" --name "$TARGET_STATIC_SITE" --query properties.apiKey --output tsv 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if [ -n "$static_site_token" ]; then
    break
  fi
  sleep 20
done
if [ -z "$static_site_token" ]; then
  echo "Unable to retrieve the Static Web App deployment token." >&2
  exit 1
fi

cd "$work_dir"
SWA_CLI_DEPLOYMENT_TOKEN="$static_site_token" npx --yes @azure/static-web-apps-cli@2.0.10 deploy "$website_dir" --env production 2>&1
unset static_site_token SWA_CLI_DEPLOYMENT_TOKEN

echo '{"backendPublished":true,"websitePublished":true}' > "$AZ_SCRIPTS_OUTPUT_PATH"
